hyperedges.label: Declassified Dossier visual and motion system

nodes.label: Anvil archive
nodes.rationale: Private-by-default archive of CTF writeups, security notes and AI-automation labs; entries only publish when explicitly marked public.

nodes.label: Declassified Dossier home concept
nodes.rationale: Site framed as a classified case file; sections are exhibits; left-aligned editorial layout, never a centered full-screen hero.

nodes.label: Redaction bars scroll wipe
nodes.rationale: GSAP clip-path inset scrub; bars are aria-hidden overlays so real text stays in the DOM for accessibility and JS-off.

nodes.label: Stack (Astro 7, React 19 islands, Tailwind 4, GSAP, Lenis, Pagefind)
nodes.norm_label: stack (astro 7, react 19 islands, tailwind 4, gsap, lenis, pagefind)

nodes.label: Public build (PUBLIC_ONLY=1)
nodes.rationale: Excludes drafts and private entries and redacts flags; build:private is local only and never deployed.

nodes.label: getPublic()
nodes.rationale: Single gate for collections so pages never call getCollection() directly and leak private/draft entries.

nodes.label: <Flag> component
nodes.rationale: Renders real flag in dev and THM{redacted} in the public build so flags never appear in plain text.

nodes.label: TryHackMe active-room policy
nodes.rationale: Active room writeups stay private per THM policy; only retired or walkthrough-permitted rooms are published.

nodes.label: Content collections (writeups, notes, labs, projects, experience)
nodes.norm_label: content collections (writeups, notes, labs, projects, experience)

nodes.label: Personal data and facts rules
nodes.rationale: Never publish phone number; employer work stays at resume level; never invent metrics, testimonials or ranks.

nodes.label: Design tokens (tokens.css / @theme)
nodes.rationale: All colours and fonts go through tokens; dark minimalist luxury palette with a single champagne accent #C9A96E.

nodes.label: Motion core (src/scripts/motion.ts)
nodes.rationale: All motion in one place; Lenis driven by gsap.ticker; cleanup on astro:before-swap; reduced-motion disables Lenis and scrub.

nodes.label: Code standards (TS strict, ESLint, Prettier, Conventional Commits, Husky)
nodes.norm_label: code standards (ts strict, eslint, prettier, conventional commits, husky)

nodes.label: Security headers (vercel.json strict CSP)
nodes.rationale: Static output only; strict CSP without unsafe-inline, HSTS, frame-ancestors none; build secrets never get PUBLIC_ prefix.

nodes.label: Build plan steps 0-15
nodes.rationale: One step at a time, each reviewed before the next starts.

nodes.label: Decisions log
nodes.rationale: Astro 7 over planned 5 (current release); Font Awesome 7 over 6; Anvil content at repo root not src/content with lab artifacts beside writeups.

nodes.label: Hallmark floor
nodes.rationale: No tracked all-caps labels or middle-dot meta strings, so dossier labels are sentence case in mono.

nodes.label: Open items (resume PDF, screenshots, THM rank, domain)
nodes.norm_label: open items (resume pdf, screenshots, thm rank, domain)

nodes.label: AGENTS.md cleanup item
nodes.rationale: AGENTS.md from the scaffold duplicates the CLAUDE.md dev-server note; delete in step 2.

nodes.label: Site Favicon (Astro logo mark)
nodes.description: 128x128 SVG favicon depicting the Astro framework logo: a stylized 'A' shape with a flame/swoosh beneath it, rendered as a single filled path.
nodes.rationale: Default Astro starter favicon; embedded CSS switches fill from black to white under prefers-color-scheme: dark so the icon stays visible on dark browser tabs.
